task_criteria: Every CLI completion lane (validate, cascade, generate, index, guard) writes a completion record, and npx vitest run tests/cli/completion.test.ts exits 0.

items.criterion: Every CLI completion lane (validate, cascade, generate, index, guard) writes a completion record, and npx vitest run tests/cli/completion.test.ts exits 0.
items.detail: bin/speclang:76-84 installs a process.once('exit') hook when argv[2] is one of [validate, cascade, generate, index, guard]; recordCliCompletion (bin/speclang:18-66) writes .speclang/cli-completion.json with {lane, exitCode, durationMs, runCount} via exclusive .lock + temp-file rename. Manual verification in a temp dir: all five lanes recorded (index/guard exit 1 as 'unknown command' in bin/speclang but still record; validate/generate/cascade recorded with their real exit codes), and a second `validate` run incremented runCount to 2 with all 5 lane keys present. Test run: `TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp npx vitest run tests/cli/completion.test.ts` → exit_code=0, 'Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 17 passed (17)'. .speclang/ is gitignored (.gitignore:38). Landed via commit 33c33ce4 'feat: record CLI lane completion outcomes and counters. Addresses OBS-4.' [resolution 0.03; tests/cli/completion.test.ts]

items.criterion: Derived (reachability): the completion-record hook is reachable from the shipped CLI entrypoint (bin/speclang) for each of the five lane names, so an actual `node bin/speclang <lane>` invocation produces a record
items.detail: bin/speclang:76 reads process.argv[2] before commander parsing, so the hook is installed for every bare lane invocation regardless of whether the command exists. Verified manually: `node bin/speclang index` → 'error: unknown command' exit=1 AND .speclang/cli-completion.json contained {"index":{exitCode:1,durationMs:7,runCount:1}}; identical for guard; validate/generate/cascade recorded with exitCode 1 from their real actions.

items.criterion: Derived (failure path): recording failures warn without changing the lane's exit code, and the exit hook cannot corrupt state or strand the lock
items.detail: bin/speclang:79 uses process.once('exit') with fully synchronous fs calls (safe in an exit handler); the catch at bin/speclang:80-83 prints 'Warning: could not record CLI completion for <lane>' to stderr and preserves the exit code; the lock fd is closed and unlinked in a finally block (bin/speclang:57-64). Pinned by tests/cli/completion.test.ts:113-131 (malformed state '{broken'/'null'/'[]' preserved byte-for-byte, lock released, exit codes 0/1 kept) and :143-149 (unwritable .speclang path warns, exit code unchanged) — all passing in the run above.
